source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC-Web -> Overview.
2. Check BMC time.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Date and time of BMC should be correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/DateTime (DateTime) so user confirms the BMC web "BMC time" page shows the correct data. No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES correctly recognizes a read-only comparison opportunity, but its fixed `/Managers/bmc/DateTime` URI treats `DateTime` as a subresource and assumes ManagerId `bmc`; standard Redfish exposes DateTime as a property of the Manager resource. `-k` disables server authentication, command-line basic credentials are exposed, and API JSON alone does not test the required Overview rendering.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED appropriately adds the reference clock, timezone, tolerance and UI/API correlation. This review sharpens Manager discovery, property-level Redfish semantics, capture latency, offset-normalized comparison and credential/TLS handling while preserving the Overview UI as the primary method.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 850/2291 accepts the malformed fixed Redfish path and `agent direct run` premise, leaves correctness to the operator and does not define timezone, tolerance, Manager identity or proof that the UI displays the same value.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1013 draft exists in the invalidated 1,000-record run.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the original Overview procedure; ED-34 treats reference, tolerance and endpoint inputs as execution readiness rather than permanent blockage; ED-35 records the API as supplemental non-equivalent evidence instead of replacing the UI; ED-38 requires protected credentials, trusted identity, no automatic retry and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify that the time shown on the target BMC WebUI Overview is current and correct relative to the Project-approved time reference, timezone/UTC-offset convention, display format and allowable measurement skew.
original_method: Open the authenticated Overview page for the identified BMC and capture its displayed date/time. Near the same instant, capture the authoritative reference clock and, where supported, read DateTime and DateTimeLocalOffset from the discovered Redfish Manager resource as corroboration; normalize offsets and compare within the approved tolerance.
manual_activity: The Project owner defines the reference clock, timezone/offset, display convention and tolerance. Browser and Redfish tooling can capture and calculate the comparison automatically after those inputs are approved; an engineer resolves ambiguous locale/DST or stale-display behavior and owns the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact BMC endpoint, certificate trust, controller identity, firmware and Overview/WebUI build
Authoritative Project time source and a capture mechanism whose own synchronization/uncertainty is known
Expected Overview timezone or UTC offset, locale/display format, DST policy and maximum allowed UI-to-reference delta
Overview time element selector plus refresh/update cadence and stale-value rule
Discovered Redfish Manager URI and platform support for DateTime, DateTimeLocalOffset and optionally DateTimeSource
Protected read-only account/session handling, capture-latency method and redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the case read-only: do not PATCH DateTime, DateTimeLocalOffset, DateTimeSource, NTP, timezone, RTC or browser/system clock as part of this verification.

Do not use `/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/DateTime` unless the vendor explicitly documents a nonstandard resource. Discover the Manager member and GET that resource; parse its properties without assuming ManagerId.

Do not use `curl -k` as the formal method and do not place reusable BMC credentials directly in a visible command line or captured transcript. Validate the intended BMC certificate and use protected secret/session handling.
Do not decide correctness from a plausible-looking time. Normalize the ISO 8601 offset, UI timezone and reference to the same time basis and account for request/render capture latency.
Do not clear dmesg, syslog, SEL or BMC logs; their timestamps are relevant evidence and clearing them would mutate the DUT and destroy correlation history.

Do not automatically retry or refresh until a desired value appears. Stop on Manager ambiguity, stale/frozen UI, missing offset semantics, clock step during capture, identity mismatch or tolerance uncertainty.
agent_execution_scope: Discover the target Manager resource from the authenticated Redfish collection and record identity before reading time properties; use the API only as corroboration for the WebUI test.
Capture the Overview value, browser locale/timezone and monotonic start/end timestamps together with a bracketed authoritative reference reading to bound observation latency.
Parse the Manager DateTime offset, compare UI-to-API and both to the reference under the approved conversion/tolerance, and report raw values plus calculations.
Preserve logs, make no time-setting changes, redact secrets and provide evidence only; never issue DUT PASS/FAIL or retry automatically.
engineer_actions: Approve the authoritative reference, UI timezone/format/DST rule, allowable skew and handling for an NTP-unsynchronized or recently stepped BMC clock.
Approve the BMC/UI identity and any vendor-specific mapping between the Overview value and Redfish Manager time properties.
Review the timestamped raw values, normalized calculation and freshness evidence, then issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not fit as written: it assumes ManagerId `bmc`, addresses DateTime as a child resource instead of a Manager property, disables TLS verification and exposes credentials. Even a successful vendor-specific response would not prove the Overview page's rendered value.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using trusted TLS and protected authentication, GET `/redfish/v1/Managers`, select the Manager member bound to the target BMC, GET that Manager resource, and extract `DateTime`, `DateTimeLocalOffset` and supported source metadata. Separately capture the Overview time and the authoritative reference, then compare normalized instants within the approved latency/skew budget.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The BMC Web Overview target, general time-correctness criterion, absent Script and 10/0-minute estimates are preserved; the DeepSeek command remains historical evidence and is not promoted as the approved method.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a synchronized three-way observation of the Overview display, discovered Redfish Manager time property and authoritative Project clock, retaining raw offset-bearing timestamps and explicit uncertainty rather than changing any clock.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact target BMC and WebUI build after its supported Manager schema and Overview field mapping are confirmed.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record the Manager `@odata.type`, firmware version and UI build; treat optional newer fields such as DateTimeSource as conditional evidence rather than mandatory universal properties.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: DMTF Redfish Data Model Specification DSP0268 (Manager DateTime and DateTimeLocalOffset properties) plus the vendor's Overview-to-Manager mapping and Project time policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Preserves the UI observation, corrects the Redfish resource/property model, discovers rather than guesses the Manager URI and defines correctness using a normalized reference and tolerance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: API agreement alone does not validate Overview rendering or freshness; UI agreement alone does not prove the BMC's authoritative time source or API representation; neither proves long-term drift or NTP failover behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: BMC identity, trusted endpoint, UI/API mapping, reference clock, timezone/format, tolerance, credentials and evidence policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Capture delay, UI refresh cadence, DST/locale formatting, an unsynchronized reference or a clock step can distort the delta; one snapshot does not measure drift.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use a vendor time API or another browser framework, but must keep the original Overview display checkpoint and document API/UI coverage difference. The actual Manager ID, reference source, timezone and tolerance are Project-specific readiness inputs, not reasons to rewrite the Master or declare permanent BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/controller, firmware/WebUI build, trusted certificate and discovered Manager URI with `@odata.type`
Redacted Overview screenshot/DOM containing the displayed date/time plus browser locale/timezone, UI freshness state and capture timestamp
Raw Manager DateTime, DateTimeLocalOffset and supported source/synchronization context from a trusted read-only GET
Authoritative reference readings bracketing the UI/API capture with source identity, synchronization status and monotonic capture duration
Explicit offset conversion and UI-to-API, UI-to-reference and API-to-reference delta calculations against the approved tolerance
Proof no clock, NTP, timezone, RTC or logs were changed; anomalies, limitations and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target the BMC Overview date/time. The source is incomplete about reference, timezone and tolerance, while DeepSeek's command is technically mismatched, but these are Review-layer readiness/method defects rather than conflicting Master purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose and read-only operation are clear. Missing endpoint, reference clock, offset convention, tolerance and vendor mapping are resolvable Project execution inputs; the case should wait for them under PACKAGE rather than be permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES to PACKAGE and rejects the fixed subresource URI, assumed ManagerId, insecure TLS and API-only proof while retaining a corrected Manager GET as corroboration.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its reference/timezone/tolerance model and adds exact Manager discovery, property semantics, capture uncertainty and no-retry safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces direct-run acceptance of the malformed command with a gated, source-faithful Overview comparison and explicit evidence calculation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No prior invalid draft exists for this sequence.

review_improvement: Prevents a failed or vendor-accidentally-valid Redfish URI, insecure endpoint access or plausible timestamp from being treated as proof that the intended Overview time is correct.
independent_technical_reasoning: Time correctness is a comparison between instants, not strings. The UI may localize or refresh slowly, while Redfish Manager DateTime carries an offset and is sampled at a different instant. A sound check therefore identifies the clock domains, brackets acquisition time, normalizes offsets and applies a declared tolerance. Redfish models DateTime on the Manager resource, so resource discovery and property parsing are required before that API can serve as trustworthy corroboration.
